# Jaai

> Jaai is an Indian direct-to-consumer brand selling premium hand-poured soy candles, gift hampers, and home fragrance products. Products are crafted in Pune, Maharashtra, India and shipped across India.

Jaai (also written Jaee) operates an online store for luxury candles and curated gifts. The brand focuses on natural soy wax, thoughtful packaging, and small-batch production.

## Entity

- **Brand name:** Jaai
- **Business type:** E-commerce retailer / candle maker
- **Location:** Pune, Maharashtra, India
- **Currency:** INR (Indian Rupee)
- **Primary categories:** Candles, gift hampers, home decor, custom gifts

## Canonical URLs

- Homepage: https://jaai-store.vercel.app/
- Shop (all products): https://jaai-store.vercel.app/shop
- Candles collection: https://jaai-store.vercel.app/shop/candles
- Sale / offers: https://jaai-store.vercel.app/sale
- About: https://jaai-store.vercel.app/about
- Product pages: https://jaai-store.vercel.app/product/{slug}

## What we sell

- Hand-poured soy wax candles (multiple fragrances and sizes)
- Gift hampers and curated sets
- Custom candle builder (when enabled)
- Custom gift hamper builder (when enabled)

## Policies (summary)

- Shipping: India-wide; free shipping may apply above order threshold (see site settings)
- Returns: Easy returns within configured return window when return policy is enabled
- Payments: Secure online checkout (e.g. Razorpay)

- Structured data: JSON-LD (Organization, WebSite, Product, BreadcrumbList, ItemList) on public pages

- Full catalog: use sitemap product URLs or GET products from the public storefront API linked from the site
